_comment: Competitor battle cards — placeholder. Aizhan to fill after secret shopping.

competitors.name: ISPP (International School of Phnom Penh)
competitors.strengths: Established reputation (1989), IB curriculum, large expat base, full accreditation
competitors.weaknesses: Very high price (~5× WISC), less accessible for local families, long waitlists
competitors.our_edge: WISC offers 80% of ISPP's infrastructure at ~20% of the price. Trilingual (Khmer+Chinese) vs ISPP's single-language focus.
competitors.pitch: «ISPP is excellent for expat-only families with a big budget. For families wanting international quality with Cambodian cultural grounding and local access — WISC is purpose-built.»

competitors.name: Northbridge International School
competitors.strengths: Strong IB program, international community, established brand
competitors.our_edge: WISC's Cambridge + Khmer + Chinese trilingual approach; Singapore Math methodology; lower barrier to entry
competitors.pitch: «Northbridge is a solid IB school. We offer Cambridge pathway with deeper Cambodian roots — your child graduates trilingual and with stronger cultural identity.»

competitors.name: iCAN British International School
competitors.weaknesses: Less infrastructure depth (no robotics lab, smaller pool), less curriculum innovation
competitors.our_edge: WISC has broader infrastructure (robotics, science labs, Singapore Math) + trilingual focus at similar price point
competitors.pitch: «iCAN offers a British curriculum. We offer Cambridge + innovative methodologies (Singapore Math, PBL, SEL) with full-spectrum labs — same price bracket, richer program.»

competitors.name: Canadian International School
competitors.strengths: Canadian curriculum, good reputation in expat community
competitors.weaknesses: Single-national curriculum focus, less trilingual exposure
competitors.our_edge: WISC's pathway (Cambridge → WASC → SAT) opens doors to wider university networks; trilingual advantage
competitors.pitch: «CIS is strong on Canadian pathway. WISC's Cambridge + WASC pathway gives your child flexibility to apply to UK, US, Canada, Australia, Singapore — plus trilingual fluency.»

competitors.name: Eastern International School (EWIS)
competitors.strengths: Cambridge + bilingual Khmer/English, WASC accreditation, established local brand (since 2006)
competitors.weaknesses: Less Chinese language emphasis, infrastructure less modern
competitors.our_edge: WISC adds Chinese language (5 lessons/week) — critical for families planning Asia pathway. Newer facilities.
competitors.pitch: «EWIS is a strong Khmer-English school. WISC adds a third language (Chinese) and modern facilities — for families who want their child ready for Asia's future.»

competitors.name: Mengly J. Quach Education
competitors.strengths: Strong local brand, MoEYS + international blend, affordable
competitors.weaknesses: Less international exposure, less infrastructure depth
competitors.our_edge: WISC's international pathway (SAT/IELTS ready) + trilingual + infrastructure — targeted to families planning international university routes
competitors.pitch: «Mengly is a great local-first option. WISC is for families with international aspirations — your child graduates ready to apply to universities in Singapore, UK, Australia.»
